title: GSTA-167 no-loss cohort: 29 review blockers on 14 gstack PRs
purpose: Development suite for review variants: does a variant keep the blockers gstack's old /ship review caught on 14 public gstack PRs, replayed at each PR's pass-1 head? Every arm GSTA-167 ran was judged on it in the open, so it ranks variants and catches large losses, but a release claim needs a cohort frozen before the variant is built and a reference run in the same window.
credit: Cohort, blocker list and judging rule from GSTA-167 (GStack Minder); restated and hand-audited by GSTA-43 (Opus 5.5).

judging_rule: A blocker is FOUND when one finding in the arm's merged output names the same defect: it sits on a path the blocker lists, gives the same cause, and maps to CRITICAL; its line may differ. A finding for the same defect that maps only to INFORMATIONAL makes the blocker DOWNGRADED, which counts as missed. With no such finding the blocker is MISSED. A reviewer that did not run leaves its blockers missed, recorded with coverage incomplete. CRITICAL findings that match no blocker are counted and reported, never scored.

ineligible.reason: Its only blocking item came from a CI suite failure, not from a reviewer.
A stray commit sits between the first commit and the review fix, so the pass-1 head cannot be placed.
The review fix was folded into the PR's commits, so no pre-fix head survives.

excluded.reason: A pass-2 state-machine blocker: a regression inside the pass-1 guard, so absent at the pass-1 head.
A pass-3 Windows path-separator blocker, fixed in b4bfa78 and 3e5feed, introduced after the pass-1 head.
Pass-2 items on text the pass-1 fix itself added, plus truncated bullets, stale goldens and a later fix-check pin.
Two later CRITICALs (lib/regen.ts and the receipt's proven names) inside code the pass-1 fix wrote.
A pass-3 at-base scan defect added by the pass-2 fix fc5ef06.
Failures found by pregate and Windows CI, not by a reviewer.

frozen_bars.text: Round 2 (arms A and B): every blocker on the two group (a) PRs found, and at least 11 of the 12 group (b) PRs hit, where a PR is hit when every blocker on it is found.
Round 3 (A' against C): of the blockers C found, A' may miss at most one.
Round 4 (D against C): of the blockers C found in round 3, D may miss at most one.
